## Dedicated Core Services

- Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT): https://cybravions.com/vapt
  OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, CERT-In aligned offensive testing across web apps, APIs, mobile, networks, and cloud.
- ISO 27001:2022 Certification & Consulting: https://cybravions.com/iso-27001
  Turnkey ISMS implementation roadmap, gap assessment, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and Stage 1 & 2 audit clearance.
- SOC 2 Type I & Type II Readiness: https://cybravions.com/soc-2
  AICPA Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) compliance, automated evidence, and CPA audit advisory.
- Cloud Security Assessment & DevSecOps: https://cybravions.com/cloud-security
  AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes CIS benchmark hardening, IAM least privilege audits, and CI/CD security gating.
- AI Security Testing & LLM Red Teaming: https://cybravions.com/ai-security
  OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection defense, RAG database security, and Prompt Armor multi-layer firewall.
- DPDP Act 2023 & Indian Regulatory Compliance: https://cybravions.com/dpdp-compliance
  Digital Personal Data Protection Act compliance, consent management, DPO advisory, CERT-In 6-hour reporting, and penalty mitigation up to ₹250 Crores.
